cylex.us.com returned HTTP 403 (bot block) for the Unique Nails hours page; hours were confirmed only indirectly via Google's closing time and search snippets.
qualityfootandankle.com Patient Intake Form.pdf now returns HTTP 404 because the whole domain is in maintenance mode, so the PDF-intake claim could not be re-verified.

Bomb Balloon Company's operating status could not be settled: Google shows 'Temporarily closed' and the newest visible review is February 2025; confirming would require contacting the business, which is out of scope.
Flash For Hair's rebrand to Dinho & Co. Hair Salon is an inference from the shared address, shared phone and the Maps redirect; no page states the rename explicitly.
